entries.exact_source_line: **Important semantic split:** `chat.runOnRunner` in WP1 is strictly read-only browser observation and is not a generic command bridge. C1 desktop Chat uses the authenticated conversation/LLM flow; it does not establish a dispatch-to-Runner grant. A future Native work command must enter the existing SPEC-279/195/205 admission boundary with its own scope, tenancy, execution and payment controls. **`llm:chat` must not imply `tool:exec`, filesystem write, shell, app control or native-team delegation.**

entries.exact_source_line: **Primary customer journey: SmartAIHub Chat → authorize/select Work Context and Workspace → plan/admit canonical task → select Native Single/Team/eligible External harness → Runner or approved cloud executor → verified output artifacts and Task Control.** Coding/Git are optional capability families, not prerequisites. The same Native Pi-backed harness shall handle document analysis, research, reporting, spreadsheet work, media preparation, file organization, browser-based research and other policy-authorized general work. External Orca installation/use is neither required nor default; Orca is a UX/research reference only unless a separately authorized SPEC-210 external adapter is deliberately enabled. The Runner is the local agent/process supervisor; SPEC-269 (general work) and SPEC-224 (software development) retain orchestration responsibility and canonical job control remains authoritative.

entries.exact_source_line: SmartAIHub SHALL deliver (1) a **first-party native harness** able to run a model/tool loop via the SmartAIHub Gateway without Codex/Claude/Orca CLI, and (2) **multi-agent execution** in which one canonical SmartAIHub task may delegate bounded child-agent work across Native, certified external CLI harnesses, A2A peers or approved cloud executors (Orca only when separately opted into as an external adapter). The resulting UX MAY resemble Orca's parallel worktrees, agent boards, terminal/diff/browser panes and mobile monitoring, but Orca itself SHALL remain optional.

entries.exact_source_line: **No duplication:** SPEC-269 owns primary/specialist assistant-team planning for general work; SPEC-224 owns durable coding lifecycle, phases and Final Verify handoff; canonical job/control/approval/ledger components own dispatch, replay, grant and settlement. SPEC-310 SHALL implement only subordinate native agent sessions, governed delegation adapters, multi-harness compatibility and read projections where ownership requires. SPEC-210 has a historically proposed Orca external CLI runtime adapter; any mandatory Orca integration clause requires a separate explicit SPEC-210 amendment. No Orca runtime is required for SPEC-310. SPEC-293 owns branch/worktree federation.
